connector.name: MCP Screenshot by KamaruSama
connector.registryDescription: Take Wayland screenshots via grim/slurp. Full screen, region, or interactive crop.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-screenshot. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kamarusama account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.

env.name: WAYLAND_DISPLAY
env.description: Wayland display identifier (e.g. wayland-1). Required for grim to find the compositor.

env.name: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
env.description: Wayland runtime directory (e.g. /run/user/1000). Required for socket lookup.
